term: abstract as neither mental nor physical (Frege's rival criterion)
definition: FregeCriterionAbstract mental physical x := ¬ mental x ∧ ¬ physical x, for supplied predicates. It is a sibling sense, not the adopted one.
note: SEP 'Abstract Objects' §3 (navigation): Frege's 'non-mental and non-sensible', amended to 'non-physical and non-mental'. The objections recorded there include mind-dependent abstracta (impure sets of mental items, abstract artifacts) and quarks and electrons for the 'sensible' version.
